missing-note.note: Workspace packages and apps with no CLAUDE.md, recorded 2026-09-16. This register may only shrink: a new package must arrive with its note, and an entry the repository has since fixed fails the gate. Burning these down is a separate pass. Two entries will not burn down the way the rest will: packages/tsconfig holds shared compiler configuration and no source, and packages/api-client is generated from the OpenAPI contract. The register does not distinguish permanent exemptions from debt, deliberately, because a register with two kinds of entry becomes a place to file things rather than a list to empty.

no-title.note: Notes with no level-one heading. Clean at 55 of 55 notes; the register exists so the rule has somewhere to be recorded if that ever stops being true, and an empty register is the rule at rest.

title-names-elsewhere.note: Notes whose title names a different area — the signature of a note copied from a neighbouring package. Clean at 55 of 55.

unstated-purpose.note: Notes that do not say what the area is, in prose, before the headings and the bullets. Clean at 55 of 55: every note here opens with its sentence, whether as a bold Purpose lead, as a plain paragraph, or under a first heading such as packages/file-type's 'What this package is'.

unfilled-template.note: Notes still carrying the placeholders of docs/conventions/area-claude-template.md. Clean at 55 of 55.
